title: 第39章 第四案：双硫仑样反应（9）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
既要又要。

既想保全儿子的名声，又想找到杀害儿子的凶手。

他们这么能耐，怎么不自己调查破案呢？

念念小脑袋猛点，对着任曼妮哐哐点赞。

其实小人儿根本没听懂任曼妮在说什么。

她只知道丁四是坏蛋，任曼妮在骂坏蛋！

李安国失笑，捏着念念柔软滑嫩的小脸，故作凶狠的问道

他身边的安老爷吓得哇哇大叫，左躲右闪，可杨志成的尸身，却偏偏倒在了安老爷的身上。

苍穹一去一回，至少，一天一夜，中间稍作休整，预计第二天晚上也能得到准信了。

吴颖感动了，总算有人站出来为她说话了，以前她还嫌弃舰队的男人太过粗鲁、不懂得体贴人，看来还是她误解了，以后肯定会好好的跟队友们相处的。

这时候，天刀宋缺的身影骤然从远处飞来，落到徐子陵身边后，忍不住看了一眼已经死去的梵清惠，心头有些悲凉。

好在今天风不大，没多久火就被扑灭了，被烧的美人娇也没有再起死回生，这就说明消灭异植的计策终于成功了。

付薇死死缠住霍展武，导致霍展武不经意的情况下，钱就被甄智虎偷走，甚至还偷客栈里面的东西，其中就有七星盘子三个。

后生们发出一阵起哄的笑声，兄弟阋于墙起了内讧，这倒是一场好戏，比他们自己亲自冲锋陷阵可有意思多了。

金氏临睡着之后，罗松却清醒了，心里念着叶氏，自己答应过早些回去陪她入寝，结果却进了金氏的房，也不知道她睡不睡得好？

直到之前的闭关期间，他才终于有所突破，成功的掌握了五行领域，虽然刚刚掌握不久，还难以发挥出来五行领域的真正威力，可是此刻用来对付对方的特暴领域还是绰绰有余的。

正准备找一个的时候，我又呆了。D级任务可以说是一排一排的，足足有几百个之多。我不禁揉了揉太阳穴。这也太难选了。

可是花莲说过，她也试图联络过这对母子，可她动用了做这么多年记者以来所有的社会关系，人脉，居然是一点线索也找不到，舌皇的儿子和他母亲，居然石沉大海一般，渺无音讯。

李煜印象中，这长枪兵，只要一招突刺就够，也不知道真假，自己想不通，正要找人讨论，这周宝就送上门来，自然不会放过，拉着周宝，将自己的想法一五一十的说了个透彻。

她坐在那里一声不吭，离人看到他这个样子之后笑着问她怎么了，是不是有什么话要对钟凌羽说，如果有的话现在追上去还来得及。

人的习惯是很难改变的，古话说，“定死的称，生死的性。”夏军有夏军的一套战法，夏军与宋军长期的战争中胜多负少，说明夏军有着自己许多的优点。

“我出两万八千五百元石！”萧岳收起了笑容，漫不经心的看着指甲说道。

当高三一班的学生陆续来到教室时，裴东来早已坐在了最后一排靠墙角的座位上，专心地做着理综试题。

联盟战线的强者们，按照早就商量好的作战计划，那些各个势力挑选出来的战力强大之人，直接迎头拦住了最前方的一批魔兽，双方展开了激烈的交锋。

一抹叙阳眼睛瞪着大大的不敢相信，然后化作一道白光就这么的回城了。而我也因为杀人而变成红名了。

Both want and want.

She wants to preserve her son's reputation, but also wants to find her son's murderer.

They are so capable, why don't they investigate and solve the case themselves?

Niannian nodded her head fiercely and praised Ren Manni.

In fact, the little man didn't understand what Ren Manni was saying at all.

She only knew that Ding Si was a bad guy, and Ren Manni was scolding the bad guy!

Li Anguo laughed, pinched Nian Nian's soft and tender face, and asked pretending to be fierce.

Mr. An next to him screamed in fright, dodging left and right, but Yang Zhicheng's body fell on Mr. An.

The sky goes back and forth, at least for a day and a night, with a short rest in between, and it is expected that the confirmation will be obtained the next night.

Wu Ying was touched. Finally, someone stood up and spoke for her. She used to think that the men in the fleet were too rude and inconsiderate. It seemed that she had misunderstood. She would definitely get along well with her teammates in the future.

At this time, the figure of Song Que, the Heavenly Sword, suddenly flew from a distance. After landing next to Xu Ziling, he couldn't help but glance at the dead Fan Qinghui, feeling a little sad in his heart.

Fortunately, the wind was not strong today, so the fire was extinguished not long after, and the burned beauty did not come back to life. This showed that the strategy to eliminate the alien plants was finally successful.

Fu Wei clung to Huo Zhanwu, causing Huo Zhanwu to inadvertently steal money from Zhen Zhihu, and even stole items from the inn, including three seven-star plates.

There was a burst of laughter from the younger students, and the brothers started fighting among themselves. It was a good show, and it was much more interesting than charging into the battle themselves.

After Jin fell asleep, Luo Song woke up, thinking about Ye in his mind. He promised to go back early to accompany her to bed, but ended up entering Jin's room. He didn't know if she slept well.

It was not until the previous retreat that he finally made a breakthrough and successfully mastered the Five Elements Domain. Although he had just mastered it a short time ago, it was difficult to exert the true power of the Five Elements Domain, but at this moment, it was more than enough to deal with the opponent's Special Violence Domain.

Just when I was about to find one, I was stunned again.D-level missions can be said to be in rows and rows, with hundreds of them in total.I couldn't help but rub my temples.This is too difficult to choose.

However, Hualien said that she also tried to contact the mother and son, but she used all the social connections and connections she had made as a reporter for so many years, but she could not find any clues. The son of the Tongue Emperor and his mother had disappeared like a sea, with no news.

In Li Yu's impression, this spearman only needed one stabbing move. He didn't know whether it was true or not. He couldn't figure it out. When he was about to find someone to discuss, Zhou Bao came to his door. Naturally, he wouldn't let it go. He pulled Zhou Bao and explained his thoughts thoroughly.

She sat there silently. After seeing him like this, Li Ren smiled and asked her what was wrong and if she had anything to say to Zhong Lingyu. If so, it was still too late to catch up now.

People's habits are difficult to change. As the old saying goes, "The name of death is the nature of life and death."

"I'll pay you 28,500 yuan!" Xiao Yue put away his smile and said while looking at his nails casually.

When students from Class 1, Grade 3, came to the classroom one after another, Pei Donglai was already sitting in the corner seat in the last row, concentrating on the comprehensive science test questions.

The strong men on the alliance front, according to the battle plan that had been discussed long ago, those powerful people selected by various forces directly stopped the group of Warcraft at the front, and the two sides launched a fierce confrontation.

Xu Yang's eyes widened in disbelief, then turned into a white light and returned to the city.And I also became famous because of killing people.
